stories.text: Clef launches open-weight decision models (Clef and Clef-flash) on Workers AI for fast classification and agentic workflows, plus a new RL platform letting developers fine-tune decision models on their own data.
stories.title: Clef: Open-weight decision models, and new RL fine-tuning platform

stories.text: Context Language Models (CLMs) manage their own context as a file, beating SOTA context management on BrowseComp-Plus and EdgeBench while enabling in-context and parametric learning of context strategies.
stories.title: Context Language Models

stories.text: Microsoft AI releases MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming for real-time transcription, expanding its voice agent model lineup.
stories.title: Microsoft AI releases new transcription and text-to-speech models for voice agents

stories.text: Broadcom coordinates a $60B credit facility to fund AI chips for Anthropic and peers, on top of a $42B convertible loan for Anthropic's $125.2B TPU lease, as the lab eyes a Nov 26 IPO at a $1.8T-$2T valuation.
stories.title: Broadcom Gathers $60B to Fund AI Chips for Anthropic and Peers

stories.text: Suno adds spoken-word generation to its music platform, letting users create voiceovers and background music together in public beta on web and mobile.
stories.title: AI music maker Suno now generates spoken words

stories.text: A patched flaw in ChatGPT's Mac app could have let hackers grab sensitive data, underscoring that AI software itself is a vulnerable target.
stories.title: A Flaw in ChatGPT’s Mac App Could Have Let Hackers Grab Sensitive Data
